Description

The engine radiator cooling system consists of a fan activated at one speed only corresponding to a high engine coolant temperature.

The operation of the fan is achieved by means of a special relay located in the engine compartment, near the battery.

The supply line for the fan is protected by a special maxifuse, whilst the circuit for energizing the relays is protected by the fuse which protects numerous other services controlled by the ignition. The fan therefore only comes on when the ignition is switched ON.
